scenarios.name: the list is household-shared: a child sees an adult's items and can tick them off

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_grocery__items (id, name, name_normalized, added_by_id, added_by_name, checked, created_at) VALUES ('i1', 'Bread', 'bread', ?, 'Parent', 0, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')
UPDATE app_grocery__items SET checked = 1, checked_by_name = 'Child' WHERE id = ?
SELECT id, checked, checked_by_name FROM app_grocery__items

scenarios.name: add_item inserts a new item and silently skips one already on the list

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_grocery__items (id, name, name_normalized, added_by_id, added_by_name, checked, created_at) VALUES ('i1', 'Milk', 'milk', ?, 'A', 0, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')
SELECT name_normalized, added_by_name FROM app_grocery__items ORDER BY name_normalized
